about_the_game:
🥷 LAST SHINOBI : A TACTICAL STRATEGY-BUILDING ROGUELIKE

Master the art of war in the shadows

💥 THE EXPERIENCE

Dive into a tactical roguelike where every decision counts. Embody a ninja and traverse hostile locations to eliminate your targets. Build a unique strategy, unlock new skills and companions, and refine your synergies to overcome your enemies. Each run is unique, each level is a strategic puzzle to solve.

⚔️ THE NINJA SCHOOLS

Choose from 4 ninja schools with vastly different styles and learn to master their unique traits to defeat your enemies.

The Tiger School - Stealth and lethal precision

The Serpent School - Specialist in daggers and poison

The Monkey School - Unpredictable and agile
The Bull School - Power and resilience

🌍 LOCATIONS TO EXPLORE

Journey through 6 available locations in search of your prey. Each offers unique enemies. Study their traits carefully if you want to survive.

TOKYO Dark streets, territory of the Demolisher gang

THE JUNGLE Dense vegetation and deadly traps, under the control of the Comandante and his militias

THE DOJO Temple of martial arts, where the old master's disciples learn forbidden techniques

SICILY Fortress of organized crime, lair of the Scarred One

THE LABORATORY Den of a mad scientist, overrun with abominable semi-human creatures

THE SANCTUARY Territory of assassins and the Shadow Cult

📈 PROGRESSION & MASTERY

EVERY RUN COUNTS After each conquered level, choose a new technique or companion. Adapt your style based on the challenges ahead.

ACTIONS Unlock new actions to expand your arsenal and increase your strategic options. Also discover powerful Legendary Actions, capable of turning the tide of battle single-handedly. Over 70 unique actions available.

COMPANIONS Recruit new companions who will assist you by attacking your enemies or enhancing your own abilities. Build a team that synergizes with your attacks and victory is assured. Over 40 unique companions available.

🎯 FORMIDABLE ENEMIE

Facing you: a gallery of unique threats that transform each battle into a tactical puzzle.

Deadly traps - Anticipate hidden dangers

Ranged shooters - Control the distances

Evasion masters - Patience and precision required

Legendary bosses - Your final targets, masters of their domain

🎮 WHY PLAY?

Pure strategy - Minimal luck, pure skill. Unlike many deckbuilding games, there is no "deck" in Last Shinobi. You always have access to all available actions and companions. It's up to you to find the best strategy based on the enemies present.


Replayability - Each run offers new challenges. The locations visited and enemies to fight are randomly determined. Adapt your build according to the locations or die.


Progression - Unlock and master a growing arsenal of actions, including the terrifying legendary actions. Unlock new companions and increase build possibilities after each game.

READY TO EMBRACE THE SHADOWS?

The ninja's path awaits you. Your targets hide in the shadows... It's time to show them who truly masters the darkness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ 2 Duo E7500 (dual-core) / AMD® Athlon™ II X2 250 (dual-core)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 460 (1 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 5830 (1 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-750 (quad-core) / AMD® Phenom™ II X4 965 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 630 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 6670 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
